outcome: cord blood IgM and IgG levels
cohort: 31 COVID-19 positive pregnant women and their neonates
finding: The study found that vertical transmission of SARS-CoV-2 infection from infected mothers to neonates is possible.
mod_finding: Of the three neonates with possible vertical transmission of SARS-CoV-2 infection, two were preterm and IUFD, and one was born full-term, admitted to NICU and later discharged in good health.
